evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.
evidence.MCL: Mild laxity of MCL with increased signal intensity insiden on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 2 injury
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: Abnormal signal intensity is noted in proximal tibia and distal femur, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
evidence.Fracture: in favor of subchondral fracture of lateral femoral condyle.
